detailed_descriptions.en: YOU MADE A DEAL WITH DEATH Every run makes you stronger. Every death unlocks new power. This roguelite ARPG auto-battler distills dungeon crawling into intense short runs with endless depth. Fight monsters, collect loot, choose permanent perks, and race against time to complete your build before the dungeon overwhelms you. Die. Unlock new upgrades, characters and even new features. Dive back in with new strategies. DEATH IS YOUR CURRENCY You literally need to die to progress. Spend meta currency earned from each run to unlock permanent stat boosts, new characters, abilities, and deeper dungeon floors. The question isn't "will I survive?" but "how much stronger will this death make me?" BUILD CRAFTING IN MINUTES Get loot and perks. Choose wisely—these choices are permanent for the run. Find synergies between your perks and equipment. Early runs end in under a minute. Late-game builds can push 15+ minutes of invincible power fantasy. No respec. No regrets. Commit to your build. MULTIPLE PLAYSTYLES Manual combat keeps clicks meaningful throughout the entire run, but auto-attack builds are viable through perk investment. Some enemies demand your attention no matter your build. Choose your approach: precision timing or strategic optimization. DESCEND INTO THE DARKNESS Crawl through cursed dungeons in a grim dark fantasy world. Each floor introduces deadlier enemies, new hazards, and tougher challenges. Unlock new dungeon tiers with more horrors and challenges. The deeper you go, the more Death rewards you.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
YOU MADE A DEAL WITH DEATH

Every run makes you stronger. Every death unlocks new power.

This roguelite ARPG auto-battler distills dungeon crawling into intense short runs with endless depth. Fight monsters, collect loot, choose permanent perks, and race against time to complete your build before the dungeon overwhelms you. Die. Unlock new  upgrades, characters and even new features. Dive back in with new strategies.

DEATH IS YOUR CURRENCY

You literally need to die to progress. Spend meta currency earned from each run to unlock permanent stat boosts, new characters, abilities, and deeper dungeon floors. The question isn't "will I survive?" but "how much stronger will this death make me?"

BUILD CRAFTING IN MINUTES

Get loot and perks. Choose wisely—these choices are permanent for the run. Find synergies between your perks and equipment. Early runs end in under a minute. Late-game builds can push 15+ minutes of invincible power fantasy. No respec. No regrets. Commit to your build.

MULTIPLE PLAYSTYLES

Manual combat keeps clicks meaningful throughout the entire run, but auto-attack builds are viable through perk investment. Some enemies demand your attention no matter your build. Choose your approach: precision timing or strategic optimization.

DESCEND INTO THE DARKNESS

Crawl through cursed dungeons in a grim dark fantasy world. Each floor introduces deadlier enemies, new hazards, and tougher challenges. Unlock new dungeon tiers with more horrors and challenges. The deeper you go, the more Death rewards you.
